title: World Championship Decks 2001: card flavor text

paragraphs.text: Closing time comes earlier to some than to others.
The warriors fought against the paralyzing waves until even their thoughts froze in place.
"Those who know only one path to victory can never hope to triumph." —The Blind Seer
"Your attack has been rendered harmless. It is, however, quite pretty." —Saprazzan vizier
You might as well try to catch water with a net.
The deep sleep of winter is not always restful.
Don't trust your secrets to the sea.
A master of tactics, the Lord of Atlantis makes his people bold in battle merely by arriving to lead them.
Not choosing sides in a war can be dangerous—but lucrative.
"Rest now. You've neither won nor lost, but this battle is over for you just the same." —Teferi
When you sink a lot of ships, it's easy to find sunken treasure.
"The paladins would be wise not to forget about the Pearl Trident. The merfolk warriors have turned the tide of more than one human war … and I have no doubt they shall do so again." —Onean scholar
Exhausting a wizard can be exhausting work.
He wastes his amazing talents on proving how amazing he really is.
"Change your mind, or I'll change it for you."
A single germ can kill more soldiers than ten thousand blades.
It roams in both the worlds of the living and the dead but belongs to neither.
"I have seen and heard much here. There are secrets within secrets. Let me show you." —Takara, to Eladamri
"Which would you like first, the insult or the injury?"
The bigger they are, the stronger its pull.
Only death breeds in stagnant water. —Urborg saying
"We need alternatives, Hanna," yelled Gerrard. "Now!"
For his family, Barrin made a funeral pyre of Tolaria.
"It is a slaughter, the death of a sea. Never speak of it again." —The Lord of Atlantis
"They weren't part of my plan, but Gaea insisted." —Urza
Gaea battles rampant death with abundant life.
Llanowar covers a million square miles, yet nobody enters the forest without the elves knowing it.
Like a volcano, it too can erupt without warning.
Like his mother before him, Darigaaz gave his life defending Dominaria from the tyranny of self-styled "gods."
"Eye of twilight, give us sight. Take our offer, give us might. Make our power tears of night."
"I want every last one of these tree-hugging, earth-loving, pointy-eared weaklings out of here. Now!"
Starke knew the voice was Takara's, but the venom was Volrath's.
"When the air burns, only death breathes deep." —Bogardan mage
Rishada is the gateway to free trade—but the key will cost you.
Deep in the heart of Urborg lie massive volcanoes whose thick black smoke covers the land with perpetual darkness.
An audience of one with the malice of thousands.
"For dim-witted, thick-skulled genetic mutants, they have pretty good aim." —Sisay
"I'll wring out your tiny mind like a sponge." —Urborg witch
Once an angel, now an abomination.
